The deposit rule

  • The 1st of each Gregorian month into the breadwinner's bank account.
  • Friday and Saturday: in the 2026 cases the deposit came on the Thursday before, so some months have two payments (December 2026, April and September 2027).
  • Eid: the ministry announces early payment case by case.
  • Eligibility results: reviewed monthly and published between the 25th and 27th.

To estimate the amount use the social security calculator, and for other dates the monthly payment calendar.

Frequently asked questions

When is the December 2026 social security payment?

Tuesday 1 December 2026 (21 Jumada al-Akhirah 1448). The January 2027 payment then comes on Thursday 31 December 2026, because 1 January is a Friday.

When do eligibility results appear?

Between the 25th and 27th of each Gregorian month according to the ministry's guide; payment starts the month after approval.

What if the 1st falls on a Friday or Saturday?

In both 2026 cases (Friday 1 May and Saturday 1 August) the deposit came on the Thursday before. In 2027 the May payment is on Thursday 29 April and October's on Thursday 30 September.
